A '''vibroglaive''', or '''vibro-glaive''', was large [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]], with a blade mounted on a long shaft. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gar (Gamorrean)|Gar]] armed himself with a vibroglaive.
